transkript.t: Claude can now build an AI trading agent
that watches the market and tells you exactly
when something changes.
Most people check their portfolio once a week
and hear about the big moves way too late.
So you plug two connectors into Claude.
Liquid trade gives it a direct line into stocks,
crypto, forex, commodities, even prediction markets.
QuiverQuant feeds at the data the pros watch.
Insider buys, what politicians are trading,
where the big funds are moving.
Then you hand Claude one rule.
Say, track a famous investor's filings.
The second they make a move,
Claude checks it against what you already own.
Breaks the trade down and pings you with what it would do.
Turn it into a routine and it keeps watching while you sleep.
And you can run the whole thing on paper money first.
So not one real dollar is at risk.
Comment stocks and I'll send you the setup guide.
